_comment: AssemblyAI RealtimeTranscriber configuration. Load this and spread into the RealtimeTranscriber constructor options.

_usage_example.note: In backend/node-service/src/index.js, import domain_vocabulary.json and spread word_boost into this config
_usage_example.code: const vocab = require('../../ai-ml/assemblyai/domain_vocabulary.json'); const realtimeConfig = { ...require('../../ai-ml/assemblyai/realtime_config.json'), word_boost: vocab.word_boost };

_field_docs.sample_rate: Audio sample rate in Hz. Must match Web Audio API AudioContext sample rate (16000 Hz recommended for speech).
_field_docs.encoding: PCM signed 16-bit little-endian — matches browser MediaRecorder raw PCM output.
_field_docs.end_utterance_silence_threshold: Milliseconds of silence before an utterance is considered complete and sent for final processing.
_field_docs.disable_partial_transcripts: Set false to receive partial (in-progress) transcripts for real-time display.
